title: Error when updating the basal profile
symptom: Since updating to AAPS 3.0.0.0 and 3.0.0.1, the user repeatedly gets 'Error when updating the basal profile' but only with the Automatisirung (automation) and not every time. Manually changing the profile does not cause this error.
cause: The pump did not respond to the command BASAL__SET_PROFILE_BASAL_RATE and BASAL__SET_PROFILE_NUMBER, but 30 seconds later the same command was successful. AAPS responded correctly by reporting the failed command. It is some kind of pump issue.
evidence_quote: It's some kind of pump issue. Pump did't respond to the command but 30 sec later the same command was succesfull. AAPS responded correctly: reported failed command.
